q: Calculate the ratio A : T for human DNA and for virus X.
Deduce, with a reason, which source has single-stranded DNA.
Virus X: A is not equal to T and G is not equal to C, so its bases are not paired across two strands.
Sea urchin DNA is 32.8% adenine. Calculate the percentage of guanine.
E. coli DNA needs more energy to separate its two strands than human DNA. Explain, using the data.
E. coli has more G and C (about 52% against 40%). Each G–C pair is held by three hydrogen bonds, an A–T pair by two.
The human values for A and T are close but not equal. Suggest two reasons.
Any two: measurement error; rounding; small amounts of damaged or chemically modified bases; contamination of the sample.
